author: ingefaerel

title: Points for improvement
body:
Quite promising app, however still some important thing missing for me. I am giving a 1 star, so the development team would notice my points for improvement. Later I can change my rating.
- Not possible to set habbit as YES/NO goal. 
- Not possible to set „clock“ goal value. E.g. „wake up before 7.00 a.m“.
- Not possible to set a range for a goal value. E.g. „sleep duration between 7 to 9 hours“. 
- Not possible to distinguish between the 0 value and „not filled value“ for a habit. I want to see blank „spot“ if I do not fill up anything, and if the value is really 0, I want to „confirm“ that first. 
- If a „build“ habit is not fulfilled, I want to see it marked with „cross“, the same way as when a „quit“ habit is not met. Instead the habit is marked with a lighter color than if it was fulfiled. It is confusing and not clear. 
- I want to have the habits sorted as I want and if I complete any, I want this habit to move to the bottom of the list. I cannot do that. I can switch to  „Bottom“ mode, but the list is not sorted as I want, but splitted into „Quit“ and „Build“ sections.

But Upgrade to Pro version is total garbage and totally unusefull. The only reasonable thing you get from it is to have more than 5 habits tracking, otherwise daily, weekly stats has only different theme and that’s it. The statistics and graphs are the same as in free version. It is not even possible to easy share throught the share button in the app , because it is some sort of text document and in most app it doesn’t show anything.
Pro version is just a waste of money.

That means that I dont have 100% habits completed even tho I do, I jist finish some of them after midnight. I suggest changing that, for me it would make using the apo more motivational. Thank you!!
